title: Farm Equipment Log Form
subtitle: Farm Equipment record recurring events, evidence, variances, review decisions, escalation, and accountable period closeout in one operational record.
description: An original, workflow-complete farm equipment operating log covering identity and routing, domain observations and evidence, accountable decisions, exceptions and escalation, and completion handoff without replacing qualified judgment.
use_case: Use for a defined operating period when staff need repeatable entries, traceable observations, visible exceptions, and a reviewed handoff. The record is owned by the fleet or farm operations owner and closes only after evidence, exceptions, disposition, and the next accountable handoff are documented.

sections.title: Farm Equipment log routing
sections.guidance: Define the period, owner, subject, and controlling identifiers.

blocks.label: Operating Log identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Assign one owner and use the same record ID in attachments and follow-up.

blocks.label: Equipment Asset identity
blocks.guidance: Preserve the identifiers used by the controlling farm, facility, or partner record.

sections.title: Farm Equipment operating context
sections.guidance: Capture the baseline needed to interpret recurring entries.

blocks.label: Entry readiness and record controls
items: Pre-use condition review recorded
Fuel or charge level recorded
Fluid condition and visible leaks observed
Tires, tracks, or ground-contact parts observed
Guards, controls, and alerts checked per site policy
Attachment identity and connection status recorded
Meter change reconciled to the activity
Post-use restriction or service need recorded
blocks.guidance: Use these confirmations at the start of the log period and revisit changed conditions.

sections.title: Farm Equipment recurring entries
sections.guidance: Record each event with enough evidence to reconstruct what occurred.

blocks.label: Farm Equipment event log
blocks.guidance: Use one row per distinct event; continue under a linked record when more rows are needed.

blocks.label: Trend, context, and supporting evidence notes

fields.label: Farm Equipment trend and evidence detail

sections.title: Farm Equipment period review and decision
sections.guidance: Review completeness, trends, and work that cannot be closed.

blocks.label: Review evidence
items: Farm Equipment entries, dates, and identifiers reconcile
Trends and abnormal events are supported by recorded evidence
Open exceptions have an owner and due point
Restrictions or holds are visible to the next operator
Qualified review was obtained where the controlling procedure requires it

blocks.label: Decision rationale, trend interpretation, and next action

sections.title: Farm Equipment exceptions and escalation
sections.guidance: Make incomplete or abnormal events visible until disposition.

blocks.label: Stop, hold, and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This record documents equipment workflow; it does not declare an asset safe or authorize work. Stop or restrict use when a condition falls outside the current manual or site procedure, and route the decision to a qualified person.

blocks.label: Farm Equipment exception triggers
items: Asset identity or meter is missing
Inspection or service interval cannot be verified
Defect remains open or condition changed
Attachment or task compatibility is unresolved
Operator assignment or access is unresolved
Required manual, part, or work record is unavailable
blocks.guidance: Mark each applicable trigger and explain any uncertainty in the exception record.

blocks.label: Farm Equipment unresolved-event register
blocks.guidance: Do not close a row until its disposition and accountable owner are explicit.

sections.title: Farm Equipment log closeout and handoff
sections.guidance: Reconcile the period and transfer remaining work.

blocks.label: Farm Equipment open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Farm Equipment handoff confirmations
items: Farm Equipment entries and period totals were reconciled
Corrections and exception records retain accountable owners
Restrictions, holds, or service needs were transferred
Next log period or review point was assigned
Source records and supporting evidence were filed
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes
